yaya.speech.label: Speech
yaya.speech.desc: Voice input (“+” → Voice input) and read-aloud for answers (the speaker button under each answer). Adds no tools for the model
yaya.speech.group.asr_desc: Voice input in the composer “+” menu
yaya.speech.cfg.tts_engine_desc: System voice needs no setup (system TTS in the Android app, browser / OS voices on desktop); other engines need the key below, and an empty URL / model / voice uses the provider default
yaya.speech.cfg.tts_speed_desc: Playback rate; adjustable any time in the player
yaya.speech.cfg.tts_browser_voice_desc: Empty = pick automatically by language; part of the voice name is enough (e.g. Xiaoxiao)
yaya.speech.cfg.instructions_desc: OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini-tts) and Gemini: describe tone, emotion and pace in plain words; MiMo: style words such as “开心 磁性”
yaya.speech.cfg.chunk_desc: Long answers are split by sentence and synthesized segment by segment; the first one is shorter so audio starts sooner
yaya.speech.cfg.language_desc: Empty = auto / follow the browser. API engines take ISO-639-1 codes (zh / en / ja …); the system voice also accepts region codes such as zh-CN
yaya.speech.cfg.prompt_desc: Proper nouns or style hints (e.g. “Simplified Chinese with punctuation”) to improve accuracy
yaya.speech.err_tts_config: The read-aloud API is not configured ({fields}): Settings → YAYA → Plugins → Speech
yaya.speech.err_asr_config: The voice-input API is not configured ({fields}): Settings → YAYA → Plugins → Speech
yaya.speech.err_empty_audio: The TTS API returned empty audio
yaya.speech.err_no_browser_tts: No system voice here: switch to an API engine in Settings → YAYA → Plugins → Speech
yaya.speech.asr.action_desc: Record and transcribe into the composer at the cursor
yaya.speech.asr.insecure: Browsers only allow the microphone over https or localhost: open the web UI from a secure address
yaya.speech.player.title: Read aloud
yaya.speech.cfg.asr_engine_desc: System voice: system speech recognition in the Android app, online recognition in Chrome / Edge (not available in the Electron desktop app); other engines need the key below
yaya.speech.cfg.base_url_desc: Empty = provider default: OpenAI api.openai.com/v1 · MiMo api.xiaomimimo.com/v1 · Gemini generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta
yaya.speech.cfg.format_desc: OpenAI-compatible APIs only; MiMo / Gemini return PCM, saved as WAV
yaya.speech.err_system_tts: The system voice reads aloud in the UI directly, not through this command
yaya.speech.err_system_asr: The system voice recognizes speech in the UI directly, not through this command
yaya.speech.asr.no_system: No system speech recognition here: pick another engine in Settings → YAYA → Plugins → Speech
yaya.speech.asr.network: Cannot reach the speech recognition service (browser online recognition needs access to Google)
yaya.speech.asr.busy: Speech recognition is busy, try again shortly
